30 feet.

An orca can travel no further than 5 feet onto land as part of an Aquatic Ambush. After it does so, it's Prone until it Crawls to return to the water.

@Localize[PF2E.NPC.Abilities.Glossary.AquaticAmbush]
actions.name: Aquatic Ambush

actions.description: The orca Swims up to its swim Speed, then Leap vertically out of the water up to 25 feet in the air, making a Strike against a creature at any point during the jump (this lets it attack a creature within 30 feet of the water's surface). After the Strike, the orca splashes back down into the water.
actions.name: Breach

actions.description: An orca can use its hearing as a precise sense at the listed range, but only underwater.
actions.name: Aquatic Echolocation 120 feet

actions.description: An orca can hold its breath for 2 hours.
actions.name: Deep Breath

name: Orca
publicNotes:
While many know orcas as "killer whales," they're actually the largest species of dolphin. These powerful animals hunt together in pods to take down seals, sharks, and even whales. Adult orcas are typically 15–25 feet long and weigh 8,000–12,000 pounds.

Dolphins encompass a wide range of aquatic mammals, all of which are social, intelligent, and widespread throughout the world's oceans.
